falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Measure the physical air gap clearance at multiple circumferential points using a feeler gauge with the rotor blocked, then re-shim or re-machine the bearing housings to restore uniform concentricity and nominal air gap length.
falsification_contract.CONTROL_BLOCKER: no executed baseline comparison on record (physics chain executed: ['PRE_REQUIREMENTS']; lifecycle MECHANISM_NOT_SIMULATABLE) — the control arm is not invented from the problem statement
falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: Clamp a true-RMS ammeter on each supply phase during no-load running; if the measured no-load current is less than 40 percent of the full-load rated current and the motor does not trip after 30 minutes, the mechanism is disproven.
falsification_contract.APPARATUS: the falsification test's own recorded instrumentation (stated within MEASUREMENT; not split out — no separate apparatus record exists)
falsification_contract.SAMPLE_BLOCKER: no sample-size / n= record exists in any engine stage (honest UNKNOWN — Art. XXV)
falsification_contract.ACCEPTANCE_THRESHOLD_BLOCKER: the recorded expected effect carries no numeric band ('Magnetizing current decreases to the nameplate no-load value, core losses normalize, and winding temperature remains below the thermal overload trip threshold d') — a prose expectation is not an acceptance threshold (Art.
